# siuser小伟

This site documents independent software, AI, creative technology, and small-team product work in Chinese.

Primary competition resources

- Competition radar: https://siuserxiaowei.com/competitions/
- Public JSON feed: https://siuserxiaowei.com/competitions.json
- Competition detail pages: https://siuserxiaowei.com/competitions/{id}/

Competition radar methodology

- Entries are curated from official sites, event platforms, government notices, public articles, and community announcements.
- The radar prioritizes software, AI agents, algorithms, security, games, creative AI, startup opportunities, and only a limited set of lightweight hardware projects.
- Descriptions, fit scores, and participation strategies are editorial aids, not statements from organizers.
- A listed deadline is not an event start date.
- Dates, eligibility, rewards, and rules must be confirmed on the linked organizer page before applying.

Update policy

- The radar is maintained through discovery, evidence collection, human review, validation, and deployment.
- It is periodically updated but is not a real-time feed.
- Link checks are read-only and automated results never replace human verification.
- A transient network error, rate limit, or bot challenge is not treated as proof that an event is closed.

Maintenance instructions

- Repository guide: docs/competition-radar-maintenance.md
- Public records expose only bounded discovery fields through competitions.json.
- Use the canonical detail page for a single competition and the external action link for official registration or rules.
